text_block_list.text:
One evening, as I was passing through the 
shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting the feeling of a big 
commotion!! A.K.A., a feeling that the 
class president is going to be playing a 
very active part!!

text_block_list.name: Market Person
text_block_list.text:
Come, now, it's time for the New Year's 
Huge Lucky Draw Festival! The special 
prize is a hot spring trip ticket!

text_block_list.name: Market Person
text_block_list.text:
First prize is a "special carrot hamburger 
steak," second prize is a "pile of 
carrots," and third prize is a "carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Market Person
text_block_list.text:
You two look close! Why don't you go ahead 
and give it a try～?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this, a lucky draw―! Then, there's 
no problem with all the fuss!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Actually, I have one of those 
lucky draw tickets!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
One of my classmates said, "Bakushin 
O-chan seems like she would like this," 
and so she gave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I can just see myself spinning that 
lottery wheel now"…was the assessment I 
gave her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is a typical example of me being 
recognized as the class president on a 
daily basis!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So let's get to it and try our hand at the 
Lucky Draw!! We only have one chance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we're aiming for!! All the 
prizes!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, then at least one special prize, I 
suppose. There's no way I won't get it, 
though!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because, as you can see, I'm a very good 
girl! There's no way the God of Fortune 
would abandon me in my time of need!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come!! Now is the time!!!! For God to 
endlessly adore the class president! To 
this exemplary class president right 
here――
choice_data_list: Hurry up and spin it already!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Very well!! Here we go! Bakushin!!

While trying to calm Sakura Bakushin O, 
who was wildly running about trying to 
spin the machine, I held the lever and 
managed to spin the lottery together with 
her.
The results were――

text_block_list.name: Market Person
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll be! Coooongratulations!! The 
special prize, a ticket for a trip to the 
hot springs, has been claimed～～～～!!
We got "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh～!! The Special Prize!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And, and!? Aren't the other balls supposed 
to be popping out too!?
choice_data_list: The special prize alone is fantastic!
The special prize alone is fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fufufuu―, that's true, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As expected, the class president is the 
one who's the very best at lottery 
drawings―!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!! After all, they say luck tends to 
suit the superior!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, it seems even the 
lottery balls want to follow me, what with 
my sheer charisma～.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When I think about it, I feel like somehow 
these balls are starting to look kind of 
cute…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Can I keep this ball in my room!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha～! It's a joke! I possess a superior 
sense of humor, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, then, I shall give this ticket to 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I still have a lot of work to do as class 
president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time! to soak in some nice, 
relaxing, leisurely hot spring… I don't! I 
don't have time to be submerged in pure 
relaxation!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When the world is so exemplary that it no 
longer needs a class president, let us go 
to that hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I trust the Trainer's reliable eyes, so!! 
Please!

…I'm not sure what that means, but I was 
supposed to keep the special prize ticket.

text_block_list.name: Market Person
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, first prize～! The prize 
is a "Special Carrot Hamburger"!
We got "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Amazing! Extra special, first class 
plus!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of special, even going to an eel 
restaurant couldn't possibly compare to 
the top-class quality of this prize 
hamburger! This is precisely a hamburger 
intended for the class president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The class president and the hamburger made 
for the class president. Once these two 
come together, what comes next is――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ――just eating it!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and of course, I'll share it with 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because the class motto for this month is! 
"Cherish a thoughtful heart."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The class president, the hamburger made 
for the class president, and the Trainer 
watching over me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I have that much, I'm absolutely sure I 
could eat an extra special hamburger, with 
exemplary-ness!

After that, I enjoyed the extra special 
taste of Sakura Bakushin O's kindness 
together with her.

text_block_list.name: Market Person
text_block_list.text:
Second prize～!! The prize is a "mountain 
of carrots"!
We got "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A mountain of them!! Mmm, that sounds 
great!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: After all, more is always better!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, with such a large amount of food, 
I worry how I could possibly eat it all～.
choice_data_list: Why don't you try cooking it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah!? So that's what this was 
about～～～～!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Food tastes better when it's cooked, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this heaping pile of 
carrots is just waiting for me to lead 
them to deliciousness!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! This Sakura Bakushin O 
right here shall bestow upon you the class 
president's wondrous existence!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All of you!! I'll make sure you graduate 
as delicious carrooots～～!!

……I'm kind of nervous about this, so I 
decided to help her whenever she ends up 
cooking.

text_block_list.name: Market Person
text_block_list.text: Third prize～! The prize is "one carrot"!
We got "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uuuuu―ghhh…… One single carrot, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ha!? Isn't it possible that there's 
something important hidden inside this 
singular carrot!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It really is just one carrot… Truly, it 
isn't symbolic of anything!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm! If you look closely at this carrot, 
you'll see a shape in it that doesn't make 
any sense!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, the item bestowed upon 
the class president can't be just a mere 
carrot…!
choice_data_list:
…Did you watch any detective dramas 
yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean!? A great detective is 
always close by!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then it's up to the 
president detective and the Trainer 
detective to compete over this one 
carrot!!

On the way home, Sakura Bakushin O and I 
had a great discussion about the true 
meaning of a carrot…

text_block_list.name: Market Person
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! The participation prize 
is a tissue～!
We got "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Shoooock…! A, a tissue…! And it's just a 
participation prize!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
… N, no! There's no way I was only given a 
mere tissue!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this must be―― a "You Did 
Your Best Award"!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In the childhood quiz competitions, 
marathons, and other competitions that I 
have challenged as class president…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I received many tissues! As an 
accompaniment to my proud "You Did Your 
Best Award"!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So therefore, this tissue is also a good 
thing――a good…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just… Did you also have that 
"Shoooock!" feeling when you got those 
tissues?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But, I'm the only one who got the "You Did 
Your Best Award"…… W, what? The other kids 
got one too…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that can't be…? Ehhhhhh～……? 
H～nnnnn…?

Sakura Bakushin O experienced a depressing 
feeling that could not be put into words…
